newsitem.title: USA: PP&L may shut Pa. Susquehanna 1 nuke today.
newsitem.headline: PP&L may shut Pa. Susquehanna 1 nuke today.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co (PP&L) said Monday it may shut the 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna 1 nuclear power unit later today following a 47-day refueling outage.
A company spokesman said, "They have some work they want to do...It's just replacement of a steam drain pipeline." The utility has not yet committed to idle the facility, he added.
The Berwick, Pa., unit was operating at 38 percent of capacity this morning after reconnecting to the power grid last Wednesday. It was scheduled to resume full power later today or early Tuesday.
Susquehanna's 1,094 MW unit 2 was operating at full output.
The two Susquehanna units are jointly owned by PP&L and Allegheny Electric Cooperative Inc.
The Susquehanna facility accounts for 30 percent of PP&L power deliveries and 20 percent of its installed generation capacity.
